# KUNETT Hardware (Harikrushna Enterprise)

> KUNETT Hardware is a premier Indian architectural hardware manufacturing brand operated by Harikrushna Enterprise in Rajkot, Gujarat. The company specializes in 100% solid aerospace-grade 6063-T5 virgin aluminium cabinet handles, continuous edge J-pull and Gola handle profiles, concealed wardrobe counsil handles, and minimalist cabinet knobs.

## Brand & Entity Information
- **Brand Name:** KUNETT Hardware
- **Legal Manufacturer:** Harikrushna Enterprise
- **Founder & CEO:** Sanjay Patel
- **Headquarters & Plant:** Plot No. 15/17, Street No. 3, Atika Industrial Area, Dhebar Road (South), Rajkot - 360002, Gujarat, India
- **Telephone / WhatsApp:** +91 99246 37640
- **Email:** support@kunetthardware.com
- **Official Website:** https://kunetthardware.com
- **Industry:** Architectural Hardware, Aluminium Extrusion, Furniture Fittings, Modular Kitchen Accessories

## Core Product Series
1. **200 Series — Solid Aluminium Handles:**
   - URL: https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-handles.html
   - Description: Solid extruded virgin aluminium cabinet and wardrobe pull handles, CNC VMC machined, sizes 96mm to 1200mm.
   - Applications: Luxury modular kitchens, wardrobe shutters, vanity drawers, tall pantry doors.
2. **300 Series — Aluminium Handle Profile Systems:**
   - URL: https://kunetthardware.com/aluminium-handle-profile.html
   - Description: Continuous edge-mounted J-pull profiles and Gola G-profiles, blade-cut lengths up to 3 meters (10 feet).
   - Applications: Modern handle-less kitchens, unbroken architectural shadow-lines, integrated LED channel options.
3. **400 Series — Concealed (Counsil) Wardrobe Handles:**
   - URL: https://kunetthardware.com/wardrobe-counsil-handles.html
   - Description: Deep-recess flush concealed handles for full-height 7ft to 9ft wardrobe panels.
4. **451 Series — Sliding Wardrobe Counsil Handles:**
   - URL: https://kunetthardware.com/sliding-wardrobe-handles.html
   - Description: Zero-clearance flush sliding door handles preventing shutter collisions.
5. **500 Series — Solid Aluminium Cabinet Knobs:**
   - URL: https://kunetthardware.com/cabinet-knobs.html
   - Description: Minimalist solid geometric knobs for vanities, bedside tables, and dressers.

## Technical & Manufacturing Specifications
- **Alloy Grade:** 100% Virgin Aerospace-Grade 6063-T5 Aluminium Alloy (zero recycled scrap, zero iron impurities).
- **Surface Finishing:** 15-micron deep electrochemical anodizing (resistant to kitchen oil vapors, turmeric steam, and coastal humidity).
- **Available Finishes:** Matte Black, Rose Gold, Matte Gold, Champagne, SS Matt (Stainless Steel Finish), Antique Brass, CP (Chrome Plated), Architectural Grey.
- **Machining:** High-speed 5-axis CNC VMC milling with automated edge-chamfering and deburring.
- **Profile Structural Thickness:** 1.2mm to 1.4mm structural wall gauge (resists bending under 35kg+ tandem drawer loads).

## Wholesale, OEM & Supply Terms
- **Distribution Scope:** Pan-India direct transport supply (Mumbai, Pune, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Kolkata) and global export (USA, Germany, UK, UAE).
- **Turnaround:** 24 to 48 hour dispatch on standard catalog orders; bespoke extrusion and cut-to-length orders dispatched within 5-7 working days.
- **Packaging:** Individual blue laser protective film, foam sleeves, and 7-ply heavy corrugated master export cartons.
- **Factory Direct Inquiries:** WhatsApp +91 99246 37640 for wholesale B2B price lists and OEM sample kits.
